title: Search returns outdated results
body: Recently updated products do not appear in search results for several hours.

title: New articles missing from search
body: Knowledge-base articles published this morning cannot be found through search.

title: Search index updates slowly
body: Renamed customer records still appear under their previous names in search.

title: Deleted records remain searchable
body: Records deleted yesterday continue to appear in global search results.

title: Search filters reset
body: Selecting a status filter works initially, but the filter disappears when moving to page two.

title: Date filter gives wrong results
body: Searching for orders from this month includes orders created last year.

title: Search pagination repeats records
body: The second results page contains many of the same records shown on the first page.

title: Export omits filtered rows
body: Exporting filtered search results creates a CSV containing only the first page.

title: Notification emails sent twice
body: Every assignment notification is delivered twice to the same recipient.

title: Duplicate alert messages
body: Users receive two identical alert emails whenever a report finishes.

title: Disabled notifications still arrive
body: I disabled weekly summaries, but the emails continue arriving every Monday.

title: Notification links open wrong record
body: The link in an assignment email opens a different customer's record.

title: Comments disappear after saving
body: A comment appears saved, but vanishes after the page is refreshed.

title: Concurrent edits overwrite comments
body: When two agents comment at the same time, only the last comment remains.

title: Comment timestamps are incorrect
body: New comments display a timestamp five hours earlier than the actual posting time.

title: Mentions do not notify users
body: Mentioning a teammate in a comment does not generate an email or in-app alert.

title: Report totals disagree with dashboard
body: The monthly revenue report total is lower than the total shown on the dashboard.

title: Scheduled report never completes
body: Our nightly report remains in processing status until it is manually cancelled.

title: PDF report has blank charts
body: Downloaded PDF reports contain headings and tables, but every chart is blank.

title: Report timezone shifts daily totals
body: Daily reports use UTC boundaries instead of our configured local timezone.
